description: Draft the recap email for the customer after a visit. Pass what_we_saw in the worker's own words (or leave it out to use measurements from a saved recording) and the next step. Nothing is sent: show the worker the draft, edit it with visits.editRecap, and send only when they approve with visits.approveRecap. Drafting again replaces the open draft.
name: visits_draftRecap

next_actions.description: Up to 3 useful next steps, best first, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one. when is now, later, check, or tell_human. due_at is set for later and check when there is a natural time. A send is tell_human: show the owner the draft, then send only when they say so.
